name: ymer
description: The directed way of working, as skills you invoke: brainstorm a topic into a direction, scout the ground, define what it means, plan it, harden the plan, implement it, review and ship — plus the supporting moves the phases lean on, kaizen's capture and summary over your working process, and the setup that checks the environment every plugin works from. Requires a Ymer Node and a state folder; a ymer.ax account is optional.

state_folder.title: State folder
state_folder.description: Required. The one folder your topics live in — any folder, under version control or not: /ymer:setup verifies it, drained topics get folders beneath it, and its history is git where it is a git work tree and your Ymer Node's notebook otherwise.
